title: Inverse Energy Cascade in Turbulent Taylor-Couette Flows
summary: The inverse energy cascade in turbulent Taylor-Couette flow is studied in line with the results of the large eddy simulation. The simulation results show that the inverse energy cascade first occurs within the core region of the flow channel of the Taylor-Couette flow at higher Reynolds number. It is uncovered that this phenomenon is induced by the pulsed zero shear stress resulting from the singularities of the Navier-Stokes equation.
